PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_accounts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,records INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,quota INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 52428800 CHECK(quota>=0),enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,CHECK(bytes>=0 AND bytes<=quota),CHECK(records>=0 AND records<=20000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_apps(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,publisher_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_accounts(id),work_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(state IN ('active','paused','deleting','deleted')),revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,active_config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',pending_config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',pending_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(bytes>=0 AND bytes<=26214400),records INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(records>=0 AND records<=10000),created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_apps_owner ON data_apps(publisher_id,id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_collections(app_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_apps(id),key TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,records INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(records>=0 AND records<=5000),change_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,deleting INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(app_id,key));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_records(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,app_id TEXT NOT NULL,collection TEXT NOT NULL,publisher_id TEXT NOT NULL,subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,charge INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(charge>=0),revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,k1,k2,k3,k4,k5,k6,FOREIGN KEY(app_id,collection) REFERENCES data_collections(app_id,key));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_scope ON data_records(app_id,collection,subject_id,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_created ON data_records(app_id,collection,subject_id,created,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_k1 ON data_records(app_id,collection,subject_id,k1,k2,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_k3 ON data_records(app_id,collection,subject_id,k3,k4,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_k5 ON data_records(app_id,collection,subject_id,k5,k6,id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_history(record_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,app_id TEXT NOT NULL,publisher_id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,charge INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(record_id,revision));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_history_expiry ON data_history(expires,record_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_history_app ON data_history(app_id,record_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_usage(subject TEXT NOT NULL,day INTEGER NOT NULL,requests INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,reads INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,writes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,read_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,write_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(subject,day));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_assertions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ok=1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_idempotency(app_id TEXT NOT NULL,collection TEXT NOT NULL,subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,key TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,record_id TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(app_id,collection,subject_id,key));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_idempotency_expiry ON data_idempotency(expires);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_credentials(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,publisher_id TEXT NOT NULL,token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,name TEXT NOT NULL,scopes TEXT NOT NULL,apps TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_credentials_owner ON data_credentials(publisher_id,created);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_grants(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,app_id TEXT NOT NULL,publisher_id TEXT NOT NULL,account_id TEXT NOT NULL,session_hash TEXT NOT NULL,work_version TEXT NOT NULL,config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,viewer_nonce TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created INTEGER NOT NULL,last_used INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_grants_expiry ON data_grants(expires);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_grants_app ON data_grants(app_id,created);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_admin ON data_records(app_id,collection,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_admin_k1 ON data_records(app_id,collection,k1,k2,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_admin_k3 ON data_records(app_id,collection,k3,k4,id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS data_records_admin_k5 ON data_records(app_id,collection,k5,k6,id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_pin_jobs(app_id TEXT NOT NULL,record_id TEXT NOT NULL,collection TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(app_id,record_id));
